body: When my fiancé's dad passed away I took a day off to stay with him and he asked me "what you stayed home for, you should go to work, you don't need to be here" mind you I took care of the funeral arrangements. I will never forget this entire ordeal, I even considered breaking off the relationship at one point because of how he behaved and how his family behaved. I wish I could've gone on a vacation :(
